name: Resist Dampening (Xeph)
body:
–

Benefit: Your powers and other psychic abilities are not easily dampened. You gain a +1 trait bonus to manifester level checks to bypass power resistance. If you can create a mind blade, you gain a +2 trait bonus to create it while inside a null psionics field.

Special: Only Xephs may select this racial trait.
